verdict.rationale: The Kimi help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among its general features alongside search, memory and skills. That indicates some first-party scheduling capability, but the evidence is only a single category heading with no detail. Missing for 10: documentation of recurring schedules (frequency or cron-style options), scheduling of multi-step agent workflows, management or monitoring of scheduled runs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
